title: Bound sparse tensor evidence fan-in before canonicalization
finding: SparseTensorEntry.evidence_sha256s was the remaining unbounded high-cardinality construction surface. _sorted_strings iterated and sorted the entire caller sequence before any tensor-specific ceiling, so one sparse claim could consume unbounded construction work and retained memory despite the packet's bounded-construction claim.
primary_claim: Each sparse tensor claim now refuses more than 64 evidence digests before reading, copying or sorting any element of an oversized evidence sequence.
gardener_decision: Reuse the existing _bounded_sequence construction guard rather than introduce an evidence collection abstraction. The tensor remains a derived Fourfold/Forest projection and no authority moves into it.
acceptance: evidence digest count is checked before _sorted_strings can iterate or sort it
an oversized sized sequence is rejected without element access
the exact 64-digest ceiling remains accepted and canonically sorted
from_dict cannot bypass the same bound with a JSON list
existing non-empty, duplicate-free sha256 validation remains delegated to the canonical schemas helper

requested: PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python -m pytest -q tests/twin/test_tensor_evidence_bounds.py tests/twin/test_tensor_construction_bounds.py tests/twin/test_tensor_kernel.py tests/twin/test_fourfold_contracts.py tests/twin/test_projection_verifier.py
verification.claim: source-level hardening plus focused regression preparation only until exact-head executable evidence exists

rollback: Revert the three G1-TENSOR-01B commits; canonical Forest/Fourfold artifacts and their identities are unchanged.
